source_location: main p.11, Fig. 10a (Fluorinated MSC-30), 77 K series (blue circles)
notes: archive: HYC-0125_fig10a_fluorinatedMSC30_77K.json (series index 2). Marker partially occluded by overlying 87 K markers (centroid from visible part; pressure likely biased low).
